segments.he: תָּנָא: בַּמֶּה דְּבָרִים אֲמוּרִים? שֶׁעֵירְבָן עִם פֵּירוֹתָיו. אֲבָל יִחֵד לוֹ קֶרֶן זָוִית, אוֹמֵר לוֹ: הֲרֵי שֶׁלְּךָ לְפָנֶיךָ.
segments.en: It is «taught: In what» cases «is this statement said,» that the bailee deducts these measures for the decrease? It is in a case «where» the bailee «mixed» the produce that he is safeguarding «with his» own «produce,» and he is unable to distinguish between them. «But» if «he designated a corner» for the produce that he is safeguarding, the bailee «says to» the owner of the produce: «That which is yours is before you,» and he does not calculate the decrease.

segments.he: וְכִי עֵירְבָן עִם פֵּירוֹתָיו מַאי הָוֵי? לִיחְזֵי לְדִידֵיהּ כַּמָּה הָוְיָין! בְּמִסְתַּפֵּק מֵהֶם.
segments.en: The Gemara asks: «And when he mixed» the produce that he is safeguarding «with his» own «produce, what of it?» Why must he calculate the decrease? «Let him see how much his» produce «was,» add the amount that was deposited with him, and calculate how much the produce diminished over time. He can then divide the loss proportionately between his produce and the deposited produce. The Gemara answers: The baraita is referring to a case «where» the bailee «took supplies from» that produce, and therefore it is impossible to ascertain the rate of decrease.

segments.he: וְלִיחְזֵי כַּמָּה אִסְתַּפַּק! דְּלָא יָדְעִי כַּמָּה אִסְתַּפַּק.
segments.en: The Gemara asks: «And let him see how much» produce «he took» as «supplies» and include this in his calculation. The Gemara answers: The baraita is referring to a case «where» the bailee «does not know» with «how much he took» as «supplies,» and therefore he must calculate the decrease based on the measures enumerated in the mishna.

moves.summary: Rates apply only where mixed with his own
